title: KnotUp 1.2.5
description: Import supported backup data and export information across KnotUp.
Improve task-save reliability and parse Hindi and Hinglish voice task details.
Import slide text from PowerPoint files and embed fonts in PDF exports.
Add Finance workflows for transfers, recurring transactions, bills, loans and finance documents.
Improve local media cleanup and task lifecycle handling.
Add further voice capture and cross-section search improvements.
